notes: AV1 videos, common in YouTube downloads, now upscale on M1 and M2 Macs; before, they stopped after a second with an encoding error. Mentioning a VHS tape in a request no longer adds an orange colour grade, and “no slow motion, just upscale” no longer slows the clip down. Clips opened from iCloud Drive, Dropbox or other folders outside Movies and Desktop now play in the editor instead of staying black. Right-click “Split here” now splits the clip, a free export cut at 60 seconds shows 1:00, and stopping an export says it was stopped. If you press Activate twice, you can still release that Mac later, and a release that can’t reach the license server can now be finished from the licence window.
